sections.heading: Overview
bullets: GW2's newest raid boss (Mount Balrior, added Nov 2024). Defiance bar only opens during specific windows at 75%/25% — miss it and the arena fills with hazards.

sections.heading: Rot the World (breakbar window)
bullets: <mark>Rot the World</mark>: Greer channels spores and briefly opens his defiance bar — break it to stagger him and cut his Empowered stacks by 10-25%. Missing this window is the fight's biggest failure point.

sections.heading: Eruption of Rot
bullets: <mark>Eruption of Rot</mark> puts a stacking indicator on several players — stack on the marked green circle and enough players inside when the timer ends stabilizes it safely. Failing spawns damaging rot walls and buffs Greer, so this isn't optional.

sections.heading: Other hazards
bullets: <mark>Rain of Spores</mark>: a torrent of exploding spores fired along a line moving toward your starting position — move away from where you're standing rather than where the boss is.
<mark>Blob of Blight</mark>: a ranged projectile that leaves a stationary hazard where it lands — move away from your own splat.
<mark>Ripples of Rot</mark>: cascading thorn walls that ripple outward, resolving into <mark>Cage of Decay</mark> — rotating rot cages with boon-corrupting pools. Don't get boxed in.
Spread out for individual mechanics, but be ready to regroup fast for the green-circle stacks.

sections.heading: Targeting & Enrage
bullets: Greer goes after whichever player (or minion) is closest in front of him — if nothing's in range he closes the gap with a Ripples of Rot leap instead.
At 99 Empowered stacks, all of his attacks become unblockable — another reason not to skip a Rot the World breakbar window.
10:00 hard enrage — defeats the whole squad outright, not just a damage buff. Treat it the same as Dhuum's or Bandit Trio's timer.

cmSections.heading: What's different in Challenge Mote ("Godspoil Greer")
bullets: Two ally titans — Ereg and Gree/Reeg — buff Greer with Might, Protection, and Resolution throughout the fight. They're not present in Normal mode at all.
Empowered now increases his damage 5% per stack, and at 99 stacks his attacks become fully unblockable — the same threshold as Normal, but reaching it is far more punishing here.
Several attacks (Ripples of Rot, Cage of Decay) apply Plague Rot instead of normal conditions — 20 stacks of poison from Enfeebling Miasma also converts into a Plague Rot stack.

Greer shields himself behind an invulnerable barrier at points while his Greerlings attack instead — and during the 10% phase, he stays invulnerable as long as any Proto-Greerlings survive, so clear them fully rather than partially.
The final Rot the World is a full raid-wide kill if the bar isn't broken — not just an arena-fill like Normal.
